subject: RM_Scorchpod
departures: body is a single blistered seed-case shell, not a segmented insect body with head, thorax and abdomen
too few legs: fewer than an insect's six, sparse and undersized for the body
shell surface beaded with liquid-metal sweat, silvery and mirror-like rather than matte chitin
faint smoke rising from the shell where light strikes it
no visible head, eyes, antennae or mandibles; the pod itself is the whole body
